first_connection_context.description: Name of the first CDR context section.

first_connection_name.description: ODBC connection name for the first context.

first_table_name.description: Database table name for the first context.

second_connection_context.description: Name of the second CDR context section.

second_connection_name.description: ODBC connection name for the second context.

second_table_name.description: Database table name for the second context.

third_connection_context.description: Name of the third CDR context section.

third_connection_name.description: ODBC connection name for the third context.

third_table_name.description: Database table name for the third context.

third_schema_name.description: Schema name for the third context (if supported).

third_usegmtime.description: Whether to use GMT time for the third context. Must be 'yes' or 'no'.

third_alias_src.description: Column alias for 'src' in the third context.

third_alias_channel.description: Column alias for 'channel' in the third context.

third_alias_dst.description: Column alias for 'dst' in the third context.

third_alias_dstchannel.description: Column alias for 'dstchannel' in the third context.
